_meta.description: Volatile, refreshable public assumptions for the Tesla Semi Benelux TCO engine. The weekly GitHub Action overwrites the priced fields; policy fields are edited by hand when legislation changes.

energy_prices._sources: NL industrial electricity (Eurostat/Intratec); NL diesel pump (GlobalPetrolPrices)

policy.aanzet_notes: Aanschafsubsidie Zero-Emissie Trucks (AanZET) — indicative per-vehicle grant for a heavy ZE tractor unit; varies by GVW class and annual budget round. Confirm current round at RVO before external use.
policy.truck_toll_notes: Dutch vrachtwagenheffing, live 2026. Indicative average tariff for a heavy tractor-trailer. Diesel trucks pay; zero-emission trucks are expected to receive a reduced/zero tariff (revenue recycled into freight greening). Confirm exact tariff band.

vehicle.semi_efficiency_notes: ~1.1 kWh/km (~1.7 kWh/mile, PepsiCo real-world). MCS Megacharger up to 1.2 MW.
